probes.AC01: Store separately typed definition, worker claim and measured test observation; only authorized evaluator plus exact policy and required trusted evidence yields ACCEPT through unchanged evaluate_verdict.

probes.durability: Real external object directory plus real temporary SQLite. File fsync -> exclusive install -> directory fsync -> digest read -> CAS. Kill subprocess immediately before/after actual SQLite commit, reopen and verify retained object/pointer. Stale CAS cannot overwrite; identical puts idempotent; incompatible object/pointer schemas refuse mutation.
